title: Innokin Prism T20S Replacement Coils - 5 Pack
description: This pack of five replacement coils for the Innokin Prism T20S vape tank are built for incredible flavour and longevity and are compatible with the Innokin Endura T20-S and EZ Watt kits and included tanks and the Vapouriz V-switch Crossover Vape Kit. They are available in a 0.8ohm resistance for a rich and flavoursome RDTL (restricted-direct-to-lung) vape, and a 1.5ohm coil for an intensely satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape. We recommend using e-liquids with a 50VG/50PG ratio, although the 1.5ohm coil would suit nicotine salt e-liquids and high-PG. Recommended Wattage Settings: Innokin Prism T20-S 0.8 ohm Coil: 16-18W Innokin Prism T20-S 1.5 ohm Coil: 13-14W
